 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAMESH CHAND  MALVIYA  ORAL ORDER 2 04-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioners apprehends their arrest in connection with Dhansoi P.S. Case No. 113 of 2025 arising out of complaint case no. 322 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 182, 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 82 of the Stamp Act.
3. As per allegation in the FIR, petitioners are alleged Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.5259 of 2026(2) dt.04-02-2026 to have sold out the property fraudulently which belongs to the complainant.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.

He next submits that petitioners have never executed any Deed in favour of the complainants Gyan Chand Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80532354/
1 and his any of the family Members rather as it appears now that by producing some fictions persons before the Registrar a forged and fabricated Deeds were created in the name of one Chandra Narayan Singh as fictitious person and petitioners have no concerned at all.

sentences.text:
Moreover, one Title Suit No. 446 of 2024 has also been filed in the Court of Sub- Judge,
Buxar, which is pending for adjudication before the competent Civil Court, as such, in the given situation, the criminal proceeding is not sustainable in the eye of law.
He further submits that petitioner has got clean antecedent as mentioned in paragraph no. 3 of the petition.
5. However, learned APP for the State oppose the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.

6. On perusal of the FIR and impugned order dated 04.11.2025, it appears that the petitioners are alleged to have Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.5259 of 2026(2) dt.04-02-2026 sold the property fraudulently which belongs to the informant and this case is purely a civil dispute and that a Title Suit No. 446 of 2024 has also been filed in the Court of Sub-Judge, Buxar.

So, considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and submissions made on behalf of the learned counsel for the petitioner, let the above named petitioners be released on bail in the event of their arrest or surrender before the Trial Court within a period of six weeks from today on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Buxar in connection with Dhansoi P.S. Case No. 113 of 2025 arising out of complaint case no. 322 of 2025 subject to condition laid down under Section 482(2) of the BNSS.

(Ramesh Chand Malviya, J) Sunnykr/-
